SELECT FROM PROJECT_FACT_EXTRACTION_ATTEMPT WHERE PROJECT_ID=#{projectId} AND FILE_ID=#{fileId} AND PARSE_RESULT_ID=#{parseResultId} AND ROLE_DECISION_ID=#{roleDecisionId} AND IDENTITY_DECISION_ID=#{identityDecisionId} AND EFFECTIVE_ROLE=#{effectiveRole} AND PROVIDER=#{provider} AND MODEL_NAME=#{modelName} AND MODEL_REVISION=#{modelRevision} AND PROMPT_VERSION=#{promptVersion} AND SCHEMA_VERSION=#{schemaVersion} ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC, ATTEMPT_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE PROJECT_FACT_EXTRACTION_ATTEMPT SET STATUS='IN_PROGRESS', CALL_COUNT=CALL_COUNT+1, ACCEPTED_COUNT=0, REJECTED_COUNT=0, FAILURE_REASON=NULL, UPDATED_AT=#{updatedAt}, VERSION_NO=VERSION_NO+1 WHERE ATTEMPT_ID=#{attemptId} AND STATUS='FAILED' AND VERSION_NO=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM PROJECT_FACT_EXTRACTION_CANDIDATE WHERE ATTEMPT_ID=#{attemptId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT, CANDIDATE_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROJECT_FACT_EXTRACTION_REJECTION (REJECTION_ID, ATTEMPT_ID, ATTEMPT_NO, SCOPE, PROVIDER_ORDINAL, STAGE, REASON_CODE, SAFE_SHAPE_HASH, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{row.rejectionId}, #{row.attemptId}, #{row.attemptNo}, #{row.scope}, #{row.providerOrdinal}, #{row.stage}, #{row.reasonCode}, #{row.safeShapeHash}, #{row.createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT REJECTION_ID, ATTEMPT_ID, ATTEMPT_NO, SCOPE, PROVIDER_ORDINAL, STAGE, REASON_CODE, SAFE_SHAPE_HASH, CREATED_AT FROM PROJECT_FACT_EXTRACTION_REJECTION WHERE ATTEMPT_ID=#{attemptId} ORDER BY ATTEMPT_NO, SCOPE, PROVIDER_ORDINAL

mapper.select: SELECT CALL_AUDIT_ID, FACT_EXTRACTION_ATTEMPT_ID, REVIEW_STEP_ATTEMPT_ID, ATTEMPT_NO, SCOPE, CALL_ORDINAL, PHASE, REQUEST_FINGERPRINT, PROVIDER, MODEL_NAME, OUTCOME, SAFE_REASON, DURATION_MS, FINISH_REASON, PROMPT_TOKENS, COMPLETION_TOKENS, TOTAL_TOKENS, BATCH_STATUS, CREATED_AT FROM CONTRACT_MODEL_CALL_AUDIT WHERE FACT_EXTRACTION_ATTEMPT_ID=#{attemptId} ORDER BY ATTEMPT_NO, SCOPE, CALL_ORDINAL
